sections.heading: SPECIALIZATION IN PSYCHOLOGY (Brescia) - ADMISSION DISCONTINUED
lines: Admission to this module is discontinued, effective September 1, 2025. Students currently enrolled in the module will be permitted to graduate upon fulfillment of the module requirements by August 31, 2029.
Completion of first-year requirements, including the following 2.0 courses with a mark of at least 60% in each course:
1.0 course in Psychology at the 1000 level.

1.0 course from: Calculus 1000A/B, Calculus 1301A/B, Calculus 1500A/B, Calculus 1501A/B, Mathematics 0110A/B, Mathematics 1225A/B, Mathematics 1228A/B, Mathematics 1229A/B, Mathematics 1600A/B, Applied Mathematics 1201A/B, Statistical Sciences 1024A/B. If Mathematics 0110A/B is selected, then either Statistical Sciences 1024A/B or Mathematics 1228A/B must be taken. Mathematics 1228A/B and Mathematics 1229A/B are preferred.
1.0 course Psychology 2850A/B and Psychology 2851A/B, or Psychology 2810 or the former Psychology 2885.
1.0 course Psychology 2855F/G and Psychology 2856F/G, or Psychology 2800E.
4.0 courses in Psychology at the 2100 level and above.
1.0 additional course in Psychology at the 2000 level or above.
Prior to May 1, 2024, this module was offered by Brescia University College.
